name: ai-meter
description: Delegate self-contained coding tasks to agents on free models (Pi, OpenCode), chosen and paced with AI Meter.

interface.shortDescription: Hand tasks to coding agents on free models
interface.longDescription: Runs a self-contained task with a coding agent already set up on this PC (Pi or OpenCode), on a free model that AI Meter finds has room. Read-only by default; tasks that change files run in a new Git worktree and are never merged. Needs AI Meter on Windows.
interface.defaultPrompt: Delegate this to a free model with AI Meter:
